speaker: Doctor
text: The prolonged bleeding time with normal platelet count, coagulation studies, and von Willebrand factor strongly suggests a defect in platelet function rather than quantity. text: RESULTS: Platelet_Aggregation_Studies: Absent aggregation with ADP, epinephrine, collagen, and ristocetin; Platelet_Function_Analyzer: P2Y12 reaction unit (PRU) undetectable, indicating complete lack of platelet activation.

speaker: Doctor
text: The absent aggregation with ristocetin specifically indicates a defect in the GPIb-IX-V complex, which mediates platelet adhesion via von Willebrand factor.
